1981-2415-2741-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2741-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

1742-1978-3363-7290.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-7290.description:
Animate The One Ring using Does Machines.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3499-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

628-3899-7213.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

2034-4068-5477-5660-7368.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2034-4068-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2438-3220-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-3220-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-5223.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-5223.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-5223.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

1409-1780-5184.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-5921-5970-6968.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1778-4053-6798-6989.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1978-3088-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-3088-4002.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

7-2060-4770-6930.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-2060-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2770-5571-6798--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-2173-5220-5708.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1976-2034-4013-5004-6643.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

215-969-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-969-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

997-3560-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
997-3560-5972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3055-5231-6553.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
3055-5231-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

2105-3484-4636-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Combat Celebrant token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.. The token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1395-4740-5078-5313.manaNeeded: {2} minus {1} for each 3 life you have and minus {1} if your storm count is 2 or greater
1395-4740-5078-5313.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
If needed, activate Treasonous Ogre by paying 3 life, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

654-1541-2034-3277-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, adding {C}{C}.
When Izzet Chronarch dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Izzet Chronarch on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Izzet Chronarch from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Izzet Chronarch and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Izzet Chronarch triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

228-1339-2757.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
You control a basic land.
228-1339-2757.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature whose toughness is equal to one, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Skullclamp triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Repeat.

141-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Illusionist's Stratagem, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Illusionist's Stratagem, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.
